blueprint.title: The Dangerous Job Offer
blueprint.setting: A small apartment living room, Saturday afternoon
blueprint.problem: 小明 must decide whether to accept a new job that he feels is unsafe.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 小明 tells 李明 that he has received a job offer but is worried about the working conditions.

beats.what: 小明 looks worried and sits down across from 李明.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: 小明 explains that he 认为 the new job is too dangerous because he must work alone at night.
beats.because: 李明 asks why he looks worried

beats.what: 李明 asks if the company provides security guards or cameras.
beats.because: 小明 mentioned it is dangerous to work alone

beats.what: 小明 says no, and adds that he 需要 peace of mind, not just money.
beats.because: 李明 asked if they provide security

beats.what: 李明 advises him to reject the offer if safety is the priority.
beats.because: 小明 said he needs safety

beats.what: 小明 agrees that 如果 he works there, he will be afraid every night.
beats.because: 李明 suggested rejecting it

blueprint.resolution: 小明 decides not to take the job because his safety is more important than the salary.

targetPlan.why: 小明 needs to express his personal belief/opinion about the job's safety.
targetPlan.speaker: 小明
targetPlan.intent: to state his opinion clearly to his friend

targetPlan.why: 小明 needs to express his requirement for safety rather than just salary.
targetPlan.speaker: 小明
targetPlan.intent: to explain what is essential for him to accept a job

targetPlan.why: 小明 needs to describe the conditional consequence of accepting the job (fear).
targetPlan.speaker: 小明
targetPlan.refersTo: the hypothetical situation of working there
targetPlan.intent: to illustrate the negative result of the choice

blueprint.title: The Job Dilemma
blueprint.setting: A small tea house on a Tuesday afternoon.
blueprint.problem: Little Li needs to decide whether to accept a new job offer that requires moving to a different city.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Little Li receives the job offer and feels uncertain, prompting him to seek advice from his friend.

beats.what: Little Li meets Little Red and expresses his anxiety about the new job offer he just received.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Little Red listens and asks for details about the new job and why Little Li is hesitant.
beats.because: Little Li expressed anxiety, prompting questions from his friend.

beats.what: Little Li explains that he needs the money but misses his family in the current city.
beats.because: Little Red asked for details about the hesitation.

beats.what: Little Red shares her perspective on what she believes is the most important factor for happiness.
beats.because: Little Li explained his conflict between money and family.

beats.what: Little Li considers Little Red's advice and realizes how his feelings would change if he took the job.
beats.because: Little Red shared her perspective on happiness.

blueprint.resolution: Little Li decides to accept the job because he believes the financial stability will allow him to bring his family to the new city sooner.

targetPlan.why: Little Li states his practical requirement for the job.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To explain why he is considering the offer despite his reservations.

targetPlan.why: Little Li emphasizes his financial need as part of his dilemma.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To justify the potential downside of leaving his family.

targetPlan.why: Little Red offers her personal opinion on what matters most.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.intent: To advise Little Li on what she values most in life.

targetPlan.why: Little Li uses a conditional to visualize the outcome of taking the job.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To process the advice and weigh the hypothetical future.

blueprint.title: Job Advice
blueprint.setting: A quiet afternoon in a city park bench
blueprint.problem: Xiao Ming is unsure whether to accept a new job offer that requires relocation
blueprint.incitingEvent: Xiao Ming tells Li Ming about the job offer and his confusion

beats.what: Xiao Ming sits with Li Ming and looks worried. He holds a piece of paper with job details.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Xiao Ming explains that a company in another city wants him. He says the salary is good, but he will be far from 妈妈.
beats.because: Li Ming asks what is wrong seeing Xiao Ming's worried face

beats.what: Xiao Ming asks for advice. He says he 需要 money for his family, but he also wants to stay close to them.
beats.because: He has stated the conflicting options (money vs. family)

beats.what: Li Ming listens carefully. He thinks it is a difficult choice. He tells Xiao Ming what he 认为 is most important.
beats.because: Xiao Ming asked for Li Ming's opinion

beats.what: Li Ming gives a conditional suggestion. He says 如果 Xiao Ming goes, he will earn more, but be alone. 如果 he stays, he is happy but poor.
beats.because: Li Ming needs to explain the consequences of each choice clearly

beats.what: Xiao Ming nods. He decides to ask 妈妈 for her opinion first. He feels better now.
beats.because: Li Ming's analysis helped Xiao Ming realize he needs more input before deciding

blueprint.resolution: Xiao Ming decides to consult his mother before making a final decision, feeling less anxious.

targetPlan.why: Xiao Ming describes the job's requirement or his own need for money
targetPlan.speaker: 小明
targetPlan.refersTo: the need for money or the job requirement
targetPlan.intent: to explain the practical side of the offer

targetPlan.why: Li Ming expresses his personal opinion on the situation
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: to give advice based on his belief

targetPlan.why: Li Ming outlines the conditional outcomes of the two choices
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: the scenarios of accepting or rejecting the job
targetPlan.intent: to clearly define the cause and effect of the decision
